title: Honorable Mention Poster Award at SDSE 2026
summary: Our work on graphite felt electrodes for vanadium redox flow batteries received an Honorable Mention poster award at SDSE 2026.
paragraphs: The poster “Nanostructured g-C3N4-Decorated Graphite Felt Electrodes for Enhanced Redox Kinetics in Vanadium Redox Flow Batteries” received an Honorable Mention award at the 4th International Conference on Smart Devices and Sustainable Energy (SDSE 2026), held in New Taipei City, Taiwan, on 14–16 October 2026.
The certificate names Iqra Shaheen, Yu-Xian Lee, Wei-Hao Chiu, Shih-Hsuan Chen, and Kun-Mu Lee as recipients.
